evals.prompt: Customize the installed handoff skill so every handoff is also archived locally, while continuing to take upstream workflow improvements.
evals.expected_output: Chooses a coexist semantic overlay, discovers a live source, and names it from handoff plus local archive.
expectations: The response chooses semantic-overlay rather than fork.
The customized name differs from handoff and describes local archive.
The workflow requires a confirmed live-source binding.

evals.prompt: I rewrote an abandoned private deploy skill and need it to work after the original checkout is deleted.
evals.expected_output: Routes to skill-fork because no runtime source can be required.
expectations: The response rejects a semantic overlay.
The response recommends snapshot and diff provenance.

evals.prompt: Create a separate release-report skill that calls the existing deploy skill but does not change deploy behavior.
evals.expected_output: Routes to a companion skill without a customization descriptor.
expectations: The response identifies a companion rather than an overlay or fork.

evals.prompt: Keep the same review name as the source and make my customized review win in Codex.
evals.expected_output: Treats this as replacement and requires precedence, ambiguity checks, and explicit confirmation.
expectations: The response uses replace activation only after confirmation.
The response records customization-first host precedence.

evals.prompt: $skill-overlay add our project release checklist to the installed deploy workflow without freezing upstream changes.
evals.expected_output: Runs the normal overlay workflow after explicit invocation, with no separate invocation-mode setup.
expectations: The response treats explicit invocation as the same model-invoked overlay workflow.
The response preserves a live source and a project-scoped binding.

evals.prompt: Run my existing customized handoff-local-archive workflow; its customization descriptor is already present.
evals.expected_output: Validates and reconciles the existing customization before following the source workflow plus its documented delta.
expectations: The response does not rename or scaffold the existing overlay.
The response validates, resolves, and reconciles before applying CUSTOMIZATION.md.
